problems.title: Correct, faster GPU kernels for expensive production workloads
problems.beneficiary: Inference providers and AI infrastructure teams with measurable recurring GPU expenditure
problems.outcome: Deliver a drop-in kernel for a frozen workload and hardware target, with correctness evidence, repeatable timing and an integration-ready rollback path.
problems.acceptance: Proposed pilot: pass every withheld shape/dtype/adversarial correctness case and beat the best qualified library, compiler and expert baseline after warm-up. Include development, validation, deployment and maintenance in payback; numeric thresholds are negotiated, not assumed.
problems.blocker: Fast candidates can exploit incomplete tests or lose when compilation, numerical corner cases and production integration are counted.

demand.basis: KernelBench provides public tasks and an evaluation approach. The buyer, production workload, savings, value threshold and commercial demand here remain hypotheses.

alternatives.name: Competent specialist
alternatives.route: Specialist GPU engineer with vendor libraries, Triton and compiler autotuning.
alternatives.unknowns: Complete quoted cost, contractual acceptance, delivery time and residual obligations are not measured.

alternatives.name: Human-plus-AI provider
alternatives.route: An infrastructure team uses current coding agents plus rigorous hardware benchmarks.
alternatives.unknowns: Current frontier-assisted specialist delivery may already satisfy the complete outcome; benchmark on equal terms.

alternatives.name: No purchase
alternatives.route: Buyer continues existing process or defers the project.
alternatives.unknowns: Actual willingness to pay and opportunity cost of inaction are unverified.

problems.next_test: Obtain a permissioned workload, freeze its test distribution and cost baseline, run isolated benchmarks on the same hardware and independently check net savings.

problems.title: Proof-carrying repairs for a critical memory-safe parsing boundary
problems.beneficiary: Software vendors maintaining high-exposure parsers and foundational libraries
problems.outcome: Deliver a scoped repair and independently replayable proof of agreed memory-safety or input-validation properties without changing required behavior.
problems.acceptance: Freeze the exact source/binary, compiler, assumptions, specification and behavior corpus. A trusted checker accepts the proof and rejects known-invalid variants; specialists assess whether the statement covers the intended property.
problems.blocker: Automated proof construction can still be expensive, and an accepted proof can establish a weaker property than the buyer needs.

demand.basis: Anthropic reported broader LLM-assisted formal verification on October 22, 2026. That motivates a scoped pilot; it is not evidence of this proposed service succeeding or a customer agreeing to pay.

alternatives.name: Competent specialist
alternatives.route: Formal-methods specialists using mature provers, static analysis and fuzz testing.
alternatives.unknowns: Complete quoted cost, contractual acceptance, delivery time and residual obligations are not measured.

alternatives.name: Human-plus-AI provider
alternatives.route: The maintainers use the publicly described AI-assisted verification pipeline themselves.
alternatives.unknowns: Current frontier-assisted specialist delivery may already satisfy the complete outcome; benchmark on equal terms.

alternatives.name: No purchase
alternatives.route: Buyer continues existing process or defers the project.
alternatives.unknowns: Actual willingness to pay and opportunity cost of inaction are unverified.

problems.next_test: Choose one authorized open-source parsing component, freeze the target property and behavior tests, and measure proof/repair cost against capable specialist alternatives.

problems.title: Constraint-safe scheduling improvements for a new operating regime
problems.beneficiary: Private cloud operators and compute-heavy businesses facing changing workload mixes
problems.outcome: Deliver a scheduler that improves a declared throughput or latency objective while respecting all resource, fairness and service-level constraints.
problems.acceptance: Replay frozen historical and held-out traces under identical hardware/capacity assumptions. Independently check every constraint, adverse shifts and complete transition costs; compare production scheduler, operations-research solver and expert-plus-AI design.
problems.blocker: An algorithm that wins one trace may fail on distribution shifts, violate a service obligation or not repay the cost of production migration.

demand.basis: AlphaEvolve is an existing algorithm-discovery comparator, announced in May 2025. This card does not claim scheduling became possible only recently; a new complete outcome and favorable economics must be demonstrated.

alternatives.name: Competent specialist
alternatives.route: Operations-research specialist and mature scheduling solvers.
alternatives.unknowns: Complete quoted cost, contractual acceptance, delivery time and residual obligations are not measured.

alternatives.name: Human-plus-AI provider
alternatives.route: The operator uses an existing algorithm-evolution system with its own evaluators.
alternatives.unknowns: Current frontier-assisted specialist delivery may already satisfy the complete outcome; benchmark on equal terms.

alternatives.name: No purchase
alternatives.route: Buyer continues existing process or defers the project.
alternatives.unknowns: Actual willingness to pay and opportunity cost of inaction are unverified.

problems.next_test: Freeze a valuable unmet service requirement and permitted telemetry, then compare matched old/current construction routes with strong complete alternatives and no deployment as controls.

problems.title: Reliable simulation surrogates for a new engineering design family
problems.beneficiary: Private engineering firms that repeatedly evaluate similar thermal or fluid designs
problems.outcome: Deliver a bounded surrogate plus uncertainty/refusal logic that shortens an agreed design loop without accepting unsafe out-of-domain predictions.
problems.acceptance: Use independently held-out geometries and boundary conditions, trusted numerical references and prospective error limits; refuse out-of-distribution inputs. Account for training data, computation, engineering validation and updates.
problems.blocker: A model may be fast in-domain but unreliable on the new design family; obtaining reference simulations and validation can erase the economic advantage.

demand.basis: NVIDIA PhysicsNeMo supplies established physics-ML tooling. Commercial value, transfer reliability and a frontier-induced threshold crossing are unverified for this proposed task.

alternatives.name: Competent specialist
alternatives.route: Conventional high-fidelity simulation, reduced-order modeling and established CAE suppliers.
alternatives.unknowns: Complete quoted cost, contractual acceptance, delivery time and residual obligations are not measured.

alternatives.name: Human-plus-AI provider
alternatives.route: A domain specialist trains a surrogate with existing PhysicsNeMo and uncertainty methods.
alternatives.unknowns: Current frontier-assisted specialist delivery may already satisfy the complete outcome; benchmark on equal terms.

alternatives.name: No purchase
alternatives.route: Buyer continues existing process or defers the project.
alternatives.unknowns: Actual willingness to pay and opportunity cost of inaction are unverified.

problems.next_test: Choose a non-safety-critical design study, freeze acceptable error and refusal criteria before fitting, and compare complete cost on unseen geometries.

problems.title: Specification-to-RTL modules with independent design assurance
problems.beneficiary: Private semiconductor and FPGA teams with precisely scoped digital-design backlogs
problems.outcome: Deliver an agreed synthesizable module with reproducible testbenches, equivalence/property checks and a declared timing/area envelope.
problems.acceptance: Freeze the specification, toolchain and reference semantics. Pass held-out simulation, formal properties and synthesis checks; compare specialist RTL and current agent-assisted design. Prototype checks do not establish fabricated silicon safety.
problems.blocker: Passing generated testbenches does not prove specification fidelity, all-state behavior, synthesis quality or downstream hardware suitability.

demand.basis: NVIDIA public Verilog evaluation tooling supports a testable route. The target buyer, specification, full delivery economics and historical frontier crossing remain unknown.

alternatives.unknowns: Complete quoted cost, contractual acceptance, delivery time and residual obligations are not measured.

alternatives.unknowns: Current frontier-assisted specialist delivery may already satisfy the complete outcome; benchmark on equal terms.

alternatives.name: No purchase

alternatives.unknowns: Actual willingness to pay and opportunity cost of inaction are unverified.

problems.title: Experimentally calibrated ranking of benign research compounds
problems.beneficiary: Private research teams prioritizing lawful, nonhazardous early-stage molecular experiments
problems.outcome: Deliver a calibrated ranked shortlist with uncertainty and explicit applicability boundaries that improves a prospectively specified experimental decision.
problems.acceptance: Use permissioned nonhazardous targets, pre-registered held-out compounds and independent measurements. Compare established docking/FEP and specialist methods; predicted affinity is not a clinical, safety or efficacy result.
problems.blocker: Computational rankings can be miscalibrated under target or chemistry shifts; laboratory validation, data rights and experimental costs dominate real usefulness.

demand.basis: The official Boltz repository supplies biomolecular interaction models. This is a research-service hypothesis, not a drug recommendation, demonstrated wet-lab result or verified customer demand.

alternatives.name: Competent specialist

alternatives.unknowns: Complete quoted cost, contractual acceptance, delivery time and residual obligations are not measured.

alternatives.unknowns: Current frontier-assisted specialist delivery may already satisfy the complete outcome; benchmark on equal terms.

alternatives.name: No purchase
alternatives.route: Buyer continues existing process or defers the project.
alternatives.unknowns: Actual willingness to pay and opportunity cost of inaction are unverified.
